source_snapshot.criteria: Leak sensor records warning/error, system takes correct protective behavior such as shutdown in one minute, and sensor recovers after the line is dry.
source_snapshot.script: No source Script; 20 attended and 20 machine minutes.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct on the irreducibly physical activity, incomplete on the hazardous literal water and hair-dryer instructions and objective acceptance evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves MANUAL ONLY while replacing unbounded liquid/heat action with a vendor-controlled method and adding evidence and emergency recovery.

historical_reviews.v3_1: The agent may arm read-only monitoring but cannot apply liquid/heat, declare physical dryness, reset the sensor or own protective-shutdown safety and final verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify that the specific liquid-detection line asserts the expected warning and protective system behavior under a safe simulated leak, then clears and returns to its approved normal state after controlled drying.
original_method: A qualified cooling/electrical operator identifies the exact line, documents its dry baseline, applies the vendor-approved bounded leak simulation, records the sensor/event and shutdown timeline, then removes the stimulus and uses only the approved drying/restoration procedure before verifying recovery.
manual_activity: A qualified operator applies and removes the physical stimulus, controls spill and electrical safety, measures the one-minute protective response, determines physical dryness and authorizes return to service. Automation may only collect read-only timestamps and events.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, leak-detection line, sensor zone and surrounding electrical/cooling components
Vendor-approved simulator or medium, application location and maximum quantity
Alarm/event mapping and expected protective action including shutdown timing tolerance
Qualified operator, PPE, spill containment and emergency isolation procedure
Approved drying method, temperature/airflow limits and dryness verification
Console/OOB monitoring, final recovery criteria and evidence/photo plan
safety_requirements: Do not drip water or coolant unless the vendor procedure explicitly authorizes that exact medium, amount and location
Do not use an ordinary hair dryer or uncontrolled heat/airflow near hardware
Preserve baseline sensor/SEL/OS state before any clear
Keep power/cooling isolation and spill response immediately available
Stop on fluid migration, electrical hazard, unexpected heating, alarm absence, uncontrolled shutdown or collateral sensor response
Capture alarm/shutdown evidence before drying or resetting
Do not repeat after abnormal behavior and do not return to service until verified dry and healthy
agent_execution_scope: Verify the supplied target/method/safety contract and capture dry-state BMC/SEL/OS baseline
Arm timestamped read-only sensor, event, power and reachability collection
Correlate the qualified operator's stimulus confirmation with warning and protective response
Preserve evidence through approved drying and recovery
Report sensor/event timing and final readback
Never apply fluid or heat, judge physical dryness, isolate equipment or issue the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact simulation and drying procedures, safety controls and shutdown oracle
Perform/supervise the physical stimulus, containment, timing and restoration
Determine that the line and surroundings are safely dry
Verify cooling/electrical health and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its human-only conclusion matches the source, but the prose omits the dangerous water/heat details, the required one-minute system response and proof of restored dry state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No remote command can replace the physical line stimulus. Use only approved read-only sensor/BMC/OS monitoring around a vendor-controlled operator procedure.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The target leak-detection line, warning/error, example one-minute shutdown, dry-state recovery and 20/20-minute estimates remain; unsafe literal methods are preserved as source wording but not authorized.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Document dry state, apply a bounded approved simulator at the exact line, record alarm and protective timing, remove the stimulus, dry within approved limits and prove line/system recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces uncontrolled water and hair-dryer actions with an approved simulator/drying contract, containment, measured shutdown behavior and return-to-service gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An electronic sensor override may support diagnostics but covers the physical detection line only if the vendor documents equivalent wet-line electrical behavior; otherwise it is not a substitute.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Real liquid or uncontrolled heat can damage sensors, insulation, connectors and energized hardware or cause hazardous shutdown.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve a non-liquid resistance simulator or dedicated test fixture. It must document equivalence to line wetting and disclose any uncovered fluid-path detection behavior; the Review cannot assume equivalence.
expected_evidence: Line/sensor/zone identity, vendor method, medium/simulator limits, operator authorization and safety plan
Timestamped dry-state physical photos and sensor/BMC/SEL/OS baseline
Operator stimulus record plus warning/error, protective action and shutdown timing evidence
Containment and any emergency isolation record
Approved drying procedure, physical dryness confirmation and sensor-clear timeline
Final cooling/electrical/SUT health, restored normal state and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, physical procedure and Criteria all target leak-line assertion and dry recovery. The raw water/hair-dryer wording is unsafe and underspecified but can be governed by a vendor-approved equivalent method without inventing a different test purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Safe medium/simulator, drying procedure, target identity and shutdown timing are finite vendor/owner inputs. They block execution readiness but not completion of the manual review.

review_improvement: Retains the correct physical/manual boundary while making the literal liquid and heat hazards explicit, preserving the one-minute protective-response claim and requiring verified dry recovery before service restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: Leak-line coverage is not just an alarm bit: it spans the physical sensing path, the system safety action and deassertion after the hazard is removed. Drying too early erases the assertion evidence, while uncontrolled heat can independently damage the line or mask recovery, so stimulus and restoration must be separately governed and timestamped.
